name: Miagete Goran, Yozora no Hoshi o: Fine Days
original_name: 見上げてごらん、夜空の星を FINE DAYS
source:
This is the fandisc for "Miagete Goran, Yozora no Hoshi o" with after stories for each of the four heroines. There are also new routes for sub-heroines Honoka and Miharu, and a downloadable route for Hinami in late June.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《仰望夜空的星辰》的粉丝碟，收录四名女主角的后日谈，还为配角穗香与美春加入新路线，并将在6月下旬追加日南的下载路线。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
